title: 交付生产覆盖文件：替换端口并保留继承配置
answer:
### overlay.yaml
```yaml
services:
  app:
    command: [serve, --production]
    ports: !override ["127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT:?APP_PORT required}:8080"]
    environment:
      LOG_LEVEL: warning
      DEBUG_ENDPOINT: !reset null
    volumes: [proddata:/data:ro]
  db:
    ports: !reset []
```

普通空列表不会清除继承的发布端口；使用!reset清除DB端口，!override整体替换app端口。卷合并按target，因此/data对应来源替换为proddata。

原理补充：
用Compose支持的config渲染查看合并后的服务、挂载、网络及插值结果，并保护可能出现的秘密。核对所用文件顺序和项目名，渲染成功后还需检查实际容器配置；文件中的期望值不自动更新已创建容器。
topic: Compose多文件唯一键合并与显式清空
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台提供普通用户的独立Docker Compose 5.1 CLI和题给文件。仅使用config渲染与校验，不连接Docker Engine，不拉镜像、不创建容器、网络或卷。全部镜像名仅作为模型数据。YAML映射键须唯一且为字符串，每个提交文件小于32KiB；仅编辑指定产物，其他材料只读。禁止include、extends、build、外部env_file等额外来源。

## 操作任务
只编辑overlay.yaml，按base.yaml→overlay.yaml顺序合并。app命令改为[serve,--production]；仅发布一个127.0.0.1:${APP_PORT}→8080/tcp端口，删除旧0.0.0.0:8080映射。LOG_LEVEL=warning，SHARED=keep仍继承，DEBUG_ENDPOINT完全移除。/data改用proddata具名卷且只读，不保留devdata挂载。db不发布任何端口。两镜像、服务和顶层卷声明保留，端口来自验收动态APP_PORT。

## 提交产物
`overlay.yaml`。

## 验收方法
官方docker-compose config实际合并三组不同APP_PORT；逐项核对端口唯一性与绑定地址、完整环境映射、命令替换、卷target唯一键与只读标志。原base和提交内容均保持不变。失败例：ports: []不会删除继承端口，普通新端口列表会与旧发布项并存。

模型通过不等于容器已运行；真实网络连通、健康检查执行和数据持久化不在本题验收范围。

import json,os,pathlib,subprocess,hashlib,yaml
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
class Strict(yaml.SafeLoader):pass
def mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
    keys=set()
    for k,v in node.value:
        if k.tag=='tag:yaml.org,2002:merge':continue
        key=loader.construct_object(k,deep=deep)
        assert isinstance(key,str) and key not in keys,'duplicate/nonstring YAML key'
        keys.add(key)
    loader.flatten_mapping(node)
    return yaml.SafeLoader.construct_mapping(loader,node,deep=deep)
def tagged(loader,node):
    if isinstance(node,yaml.SequenceNode):return loader.construct_sequence(node,deep=True)
    if isinstance(node,yaml.MappingNode):return mapping(loader,node,True)
    return loader.construct_scalar(node)
Strict.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
Strict.add_constructor('!override',tagged);Strict.add_constructor('!reset',tagged)
def parse(name,allow_runtime_env=False):
    p=root/name;assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and p.stat().st_size<32768
    value=yaml.load(p.read_text(),Loader=Strict);assert isinstance(value,dict)
    assert set(value)<={'services','networks','volumes','name'},'no include/extends/build or unrelated input source'
    for service in value.get('services',{}).values():
        assert isinstance(service,dict) and set(service)<={'image','command','ports','environment','volumes','networks','env_file','depends_on','profiles','healthcheck'},'only the stated model fields are permitted'
        if 'env_file' in service:
            assert allow_runtime_env,'environment source is not part of this task'
            entries=service['env_file'] if isinstance(service['env_file'],list) else [service['env_file']]
            assert len(entries)==1
            entry=entries[0]
            assert entry=='runtime.env' or (isinstance(entry,dict) and set(entry)<={'path','required'} and entry.get('path')=='runtime.env' and entry.get('required',True) is True),'external environment sources are forbidden'
    return value
def native(files,flags=(),variables=None,envfile=None):
    env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith(('DOCKER_','COMPOSE_')) and k not in ('APP_PORT','IMAGE_TAG','APP_LOG_LEVEL','APP_TOKEN','LOG_LEVEL','EMPTY')}
    env.update(DOCKER_HOST='tcp://127.0.0.1:1',COMPOSE_DISABLE_ENV_FILE='true')
    env.update(variables or {})
    args=['docker-compose','--project-name','opsforge-model','--project-directory',str(root),*flags]
    if envfile:args+=['--env-file',envfile]
    for name in files:args+=['-f',name]
    result=subprocess.run([*args,'config','--format','json'],cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
    assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr
    return json.loads(result.stdout)

import secrets
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'base.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='ceeb1858b3cd08cba0c23e8772d4abed6e5c873756620e38df7dc92e30a1fada'
overlay=parse('overlay.yaml');assert set(overlay)=={'services'} and set(overlay['services'])=={'app','db'}
before=(root/'overlay.yaml').read_bytes()
for port in (18080,28080,30000+secrets.randbelow(10000)):
    model=native(['base.yaml','overlay.yaml'],variables={'APP_PORT':str(port)})
    assert set(model['services'])=={'app','db'}
    app=model['services']['app'];db=model['services']['db']
    assert app['image']=='registry.example.invalid/app:teaching' and db['image']=='postgres:16-alpine'
    assert app['command']==['serve','--production']
    assert app['environment']=={'LOG_LEVEL':'warning','SHARED':'keep'}
    ports=app['ports'];assert len(ports)==1 and ports[0]['host_ip']=='127.0.0.1' and ports[0]['target']==8080 and ports[0]['published']==str(port) and ports[0]['protocol']=='tcp'
    assert not db.get('ports'),'an empty untagged overlay list does not clear inherited ports'
    mounts=app['volumes'];assert len(mounts)==1 and mounts[0]['type']=='volume' and mounts[0]['source']=='proddata' and mounts[0]['target']=='/data' and mounts[0]['read_only'] is True
assert (root/'overlay.yaml').read_bytes()==before
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'base.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='ceeb1858b3cd08cba0c23e8772d4abed6e5c873756620e38df7dc92e30a1fada'

title: 分离Compose插值变量与应用运行环境
answer:
### compose.yaml
```yaml
services:
  app:
    image: "registry.example.invalid/app:${IMAGE_TAG:?IMAGE_TAG required}"
    env_file: runtime.env
    environment:
      LOG_LEVEL: "${APP_LOG_LEVEL:-info}"
      EMPTY: ""
```

CLI的--env-file提供插值输入，服务env_file提供应用环境；两者用途独立。environment中的显式空值覆盖env_file，同样要区分:-与-对空字符串的处理。

原理补充：
.env等来源可参与Compose文件插值，服务env_file用于向容器提供环境变量，两者作用层次不同。用config及容器inspect核对最终值并避免泄密；修改文件后需验证实例是否被重建或实际更新。
source: OpsForge 容器运行管理补充题

topic: Compose profile选择与模型依赖闭包
title: 修复可选工具的Profiles与核心依赖闭包
answer:
### compose.yaml
```yaml
services:
  app:
    image: registry.example.invalid/app:teaching
    depends_on: [db]
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
  debug:
    image: busybox:1.36
    profiles: [debug]
    depends_on: [db]
  backup:
    image: busybox:1.36
    profiles: [ops]
    depends_on: [db]
```

核心依赖服务不应该只落入可选profile；可选工具按用途分组，依赖对象仍须出现在对应的最终模型。此处service_started是模型约束，不能保证真实业务ready。

原理补充：
profiles用于选择部分服务是否参与本次启动，未启用的服务可能不会创建。明确启动目标、profile集合和依赖关系，检查渲染及实际服务列表；不能把可选调试服务的缺席误判为主业务故障。
